results.title: About Me — Aditya Kumar Singh
results.markdown:
I'm a software engineer based in **Chennai, India** — currently building **NexClip**, an AI-powered pipeline that turns long-form 16:9 videos into 9:16 vertical short clips using Gemini 2.5 Flash, Grok STT, and ImageKit, with Inngest orchestrating the background processing.

I'm pursuing a **B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute** (CGPA 8.33, class of 2027). I build robust web apps using **React, Angular and TypeScript** on the frontend, and **Node.js, Express, Flask, PostgreSQL and MongoDB** on the backend, alongside AI prompt engineering and RAG/vector-search prototyping.

My experience includes a **Frontend Development Internship at Slaylewks**, where I built reusable React components and collaborated in sprints, and a **Digital & Automation Support Internship at Nicky's Cafe**, where I prototyped customer chatbots and explored RAG architectures.

When an alert is triggered—via the SOS button, simulated voice activation, or abnormal telemetry triggers—the alert status and GPS coordinates are broadcast instantly to trusted contacts and the emergency console. results.title: NexClip — Aditya Kumar Singh
results.markdown:
Introduction

## Automating short-form video creation.

NexClip is an intelligent pipeline built to streamline content creation by extracting high-engagement vertical shorts from traditional wide videos.

It automates transcription with Grok Speech-to-Text (STT) and utilizes Gemini 2.5 Flash to pinpoint the most engaging highlights of the video. It then auto-generates context-aware titles and subtitles to maximize viewer retention.

Architecture

## Reliable background processing.

Video manipulation, transcription, and AI evaluation are resource-intensive tasks. To handle them without impacting user response times, NexClip delegates these workloads to async background workers.

Inngest acts as the orchestration engine, coordinating tasks, tracking processing states, and handling retries if APIs fail. Face-aware vertical reframing and automated clipping are processed via ImageKit, reducing server rendering load.

Gemini 2.5

Used for smart content selection

Async

Orchestration handled via Inngest

What's inside

## Key features.

Short Clips Pipeline

Convert standard 16:9 landscape videos to 9:16 vertical format on the fly.

Grok STT & Gemini

Automated transcription coupled with AI analysis to locate high-impact moments.

Async Orchestration

Uses Inngest to organize heavy workloads in background queues with backoff retries.

Smart Trimming

Intelligent clipping and reframing via ImageKit to focus on the speaker.

Built with

Next.jsTypeScriptGemini 2.5 FlashGrok STTImageKitInngestPostgreSQL
